tagline.en: From a Mongolian border post to the Gulf of Tonkin, over the Loess Plateau, the Qinling, the Sichuan basin and the Guizhou plateau
tagline.zh: 从中蒙边境口岸到北部湾，翻越黄土高原、秦岭，穿过四川盆地和贵州高原

end.en: Mandula port on the Mongolian border, Darhan Muminggan Banner, Inner Mongolia
end.zh: 内蒙古达尔罕茂明安联合旗满都拉口岸（中蒙边境）

en: G210 crosses China from north to south. It begins at Mandula, a port on the Mongolian border, runs through Bayan Obo and Baotou, crosses the Ordos plateau to northern Shaanxi and Yan'an, and reaches Xi'an. South of Xi'an it climbs over the Qinling to Ankang, crosses the Daba mountains into Sichuan, passes Chongqing and Guiyang, and ends at Fangchenggang on the Gulf of Tonkin. Until 2013 it was the Baotou–Nanning road, 3,097 km long by the Encyclopedia of China as cited in Chinese Wikipedia; the 2013 plan extended it at both ends, north to Mandula and south to Fangchenggang, and moved the Qinling crossing to the Ziwu valley.

Each part has its own history: north of Xi'an it is the old Xi'an–Baotou road, between Chongqing and Guizhou it follows the Sichuan–Guizhou road of 1935, and in the Qinling it is still a narrow mountain road. The atlas draws it as one piece.
zh: G210 纵贯中国南北。起点是中蒙边境的满都拉口岸，经白云鄂博、包头，穿过鄂尔多斯高原进入陕北，经延安到西安。西安以南翻越秦岭到安康，越大巴山入川，经重庆、贵阳，止于北部湾畔的防城港。2013 年以前它是包头至南宁公路，据《中国大百科全书》（转引自中文维基百科，210国道）全长 3097 公里；2013 年规划把它向两端延伸，北到满都拉、南到防城港，并把秦岭段改走子午道。
各段各有来历：西安以北是旧西包公路，重庆至贵州一段沿用 1935 年的川黔公路，秦岭段至今仍是狭窄山路。本图集将其绘为一段。

en: The Qinling stretch in Ningshan county is the road's bottleneck. According to the Ankang city government, the 116 km from Ningshan town to the Xi'an boundary is a third-class road crossing the Qinling ridge, Yuehe Liang and Pinghe Liang, where ice lies for about five months of the year; because it runs through the Qinling national park it cannot be widened, and it carries fewer than 500 vehicles a day. The Ningshan county transport bureau says the section was built as a gravel road in 1958, asphalted in 1972 and rebuilt to a 7.5 m third-class road in 2002. A 2.775 km tunnel under Yuehe Liang and a bypass of Ningshan town are the main recent works there.

In Inner Mongolia the northern extension was built new as class-I road: 130.031 km from Mandula to Bayan Obo with a 28.479 km link to Bailingmiao, and then 89.409 km from Bayan Obo to Guyang, whose pavement was completed on 29 September 2025. Round Xi'an a 60.1 km bypass from Xiadazhai to Houguanzhai began in November 2022.
zh: 宁陕县境内的秦岭段是全线瓶颈。据安康市政府，宁陕县城至西安界 116 公里为三级公路，翻越秦岭梁、月河梁、平河梁，一年中约 5 个月有冰雪；因穿过秦岭国家公园，无法拓宽，日交通量不足 500 辆。据宁陕县交通运输局，该段 1958 年建成砂石路，1972 年铺沥青，2002 年改建为 7.5 米宽三级公路。近年的主要工程是 2.775 公里的月河梁隧道和宁陕县城过境段。
内蒙古境内的北延段按一级公路新建：满都拉至白云鄂博 130.031 公里，另有至百灵庙连接线 28.479 公里；白云鄂博至固阳 89.409 公里，2025 年 9 月 29 日路面完工。西安外围，下达寨至后官寨 60.1 公里的绕城段 2022 年 11 月开工。

en: The northern part began as the Xianyang–Yulin road, started in 1932 and finished in 1935; Yang Hucheng had it repaired in 1936. In 1937 the Shaan–Gan–Ning border region government built links of its own, 77 km from Yaodian to Yongping and 36.7 km from Yanchuan to Yongping. In 1952 the road was rebuilt with a 7.5 m formation; in 1964 the road was renamed the Xi'an–Baotou road and the Xi'an–Yan'an section was asphalted, and in 1980 it was given the number G210 (all as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 210国道).

Further south the road between Chongqing and Guizhou is the Sichuan–Guizhou road of 1935, and places in Chongqing's Nan'an district still carry names counted in li along it, such as Sigongli. In 2013 the national road plan extended the route to Mandula and Fangchenggang, and the provinces have since been building the new parts and bypassing the towns.
zh: 北段起源于咸榆公路，1932 年开工，1935 年建成；1936 年杨虎城下令整修。1937 年陕甘宁边区政府自修联络线：姚店至永坪 77 公里、延川至永坪 36.7 公里。1952 年改建为 7.5 米路基；1964 年更名为西包公路，西安至延安段铺成沥青路面；1980 年定为 210 国道（均据中文维基百科，210国道）。
再往南，重庆至贵州一段沿用 1935 年的川黔公路，重庆南岸区至今仍有四公里等以里程命名的地名。2013 年国道网规划把路线延伸到满都拉和防城港，此后各省陆续修建新增路段、修建县城绕行线。

en: No cost exists for the whole route; sections are priced and funded one at a time. The Bayan Obo–Guyang class-I section, 89.409 km, has a budget of 3.298 billion yuan by a trade report; the Baotou development and reform commission said 2.13 billion had been spent by July 2025, and in September 2025 500 million yuan of special local-government bonds were added in September 2025. The Xi'an bypass from Xiadazhai to Houguanzhai, 60.1 km, is budgeted at 7.42 billion yuan. In Ningshan the town bypass is budgeted at 536.8 million yuan by a 2023 report (another gives 502 million), and the Yuehe Liang tunnel at 261 million.
zh: 全线没有总造价，各段分别计价、分别出资。白云鄂博至固阳一级公路 89.409 公里，据行业网站总投资 32.98 亿元；包头市发展改革委称截至 2025 年 7 月已完成投资 21.3 亿元，2025 年 9 月又安排地方政府专项债券 5 亿元。西安下达寨至后官寨绕城段 60.1 公里，总投资 74.2 亿元。宁陕县城过境段据 2023 年报道投资 5.368 亿元（另一说 5.02 亿元），月河梁隧道 2.61 亿元。

why.en: No cost exists for the whole route: it joins roads built from the 1930s onwards and is rebuilt section by section, each priced separately. See the section figures below.
why.zh: 全线没有总造价：路线连接了 20 世纪 30 年代以来修建的各段道路，并分段改造、分段计价。见下方各段数字。

value.en: Section by section. Mandula–Bayan Obo: national subsidy plus local funds. Gaoling bypass, Xi'an (10.3 km, 290 million yuan): national subsidy plus Xi'an city and Gaoling district funds. Bayan Obo–Guyang: includes 500 million yuan of local special bonds.
value.zh: 分段出资。满都拉至白云鄂博：国家补助加地方自筹。西安高陵过境段（10.3 公里，2.9 亿元）：国家补助加西安市、高陵区资金。白云鄂博至固阳：包括 5 亿元地方专项债券。

figures.source: Mandula–Bayan Obo tender notice (bid.9to.com); Shaanxi Development and Reform Commission, 2015; Inner Mongolia press report on special bonds, September 2025

timeline.en: Work begins on the Xianyang–Yulin road.
The Xianyang–Yulin road and the Sichuan–Guizhou road are completed.
timeline.zh: 咸榆公路建成；川黔公路建成。

timeline.en: The Shaan–Gan–Ning border region builds the Yaodian–Yongping road.
timeline.zh: 陕甘宁边区修建姚店至永坪公路。

timeline.en: A gravel road is built through Ningshan in the Qinling.
timeline.zh: 秦岭宁陕段建成砂石路。

timeline.en: The road is renamed the Xi'an–Baotou road; Xi'an–Yan'an is asphalted.
timeline.zh: 更名为西包公路，西安至延安段铺成沥青路面。

timeline.en: The Ningshan section is rebuilt as a 7.5 m third-class road.
timeline.zh: 宁陕段改建为 7.5 米宽三级公路。

timeline.en: The national road plan extends the route to Mandula and Fangchenggang.
timeline.zh: 国道网规划把路线延伸到满都拉和防城港。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Xiadazhai–Houguanzhai bypass of Xi'an in November.
timeline.zh: 11 月，西安下达寨至后官寨段开工。

timeline.en: The Bayan Obo–Guyang section's pavement is completed on 29 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 29 日，白云鄂博至固阳段路面完工。
